source: Team27 Research Page.docx, Yimeng section and exercise notes
disclaimer: Transcribed team research notes for a class prototype. These are not clinically validated thresholds.

formula_notes: Research note: relative squat depth is y displacement divided by height.
Runtime minimum depth is 32.1% minus a 3 percentage point tolerance = 29.1% (0.291).
Runtime maximum hip/waist return drift is 0.48% + 0.02% = 0.50% (0.005).
Runtime maximum head return drift is 0.163% + 0.006% = 0.169% (0.00169).
Runtime estimates height from detected nose-to-ankle image distance; this is a prototype approximation, not the same measurement setup as the research source.

plank.note: The prototype accepts 178-192 degrees inclusively and counts a 10-second hold. Endpoint inclusion and duration are prototype choices; the research notes do not specify them. Confirm the side-view angle convention.

bicep_curl.note: The runtime uses the research endpoint cues to define a provisional full repetition sequence; the notes do not state this transition explicitly.

arm_rainbow.note: Prototype counts a one-arm raise and return in a front-facing view. The notes give no numeric thresholds; all three runtime thresholds are provisional.

farmers_carry.note: The runtime approximates the torso angle with shoulder and hip landmarks and counts a 10-second hold under 8 degrees. Landmark substitution and duration are provisional because the notes specify neither.

good_morning.note: The runtime combines a hip angle at least 84.5 degrees with a straight-leg deviation below 12 degrees and uses 140-degree hinge / 160-degree standing endpoints to count a rep. The rep endpoints are provisional; confirm the research angle convention and how its conditions combine.
